background.zh: 收錄於讚美之泉敬拜讚美專輯(17)《將天敞開》（Open Heaven，2012），詞、曲：游智婷（Sandy Yu）。© 2012 Stream of Praise Music / BMI，CCLI Song #6400510。歌曲中段引用 William Cowper 的公有領域聖詩〈有一血泉 There Is a Fountain Filled with Blood〉（「永遠與罪隔離」即 “Lose all their guilty stains”）。本檔案收錄中英歌詞，請於教會使用時依 CCLI 授權規範播放與投影。
background.en: From Stream of Praise's worship album (17) "Open Heaven" (2012). Words and music by Sandy Yu. © 2012 Stream of Praise Music / BMI, CCLI Song #6400510. The middle section quotes William Cowper's public-domain hymn "There Is a Fountain Filled with Blood" (the line 永遠與罪隔離 corresponds to "Lose all their guilty stains"). Lyrics included for display under your church's CCLI license.

zh: 我記念祢 親愛耶穌
十架上 祢換回我生命
使我回到 天父面前
en: Every time I look upon this bread,
I think of You and all You've done.
For the cross has given me new life,
that I may see Your face.

zh: 我感謝祢 我的耶穌
祢寶血 洗淨我的罪
使我永遠 與罪隔離
en: Every time I look upon this cup,
I thank You for the things You've done.
For Your blood has cleansed me from my sins
that I may be forever clean

zh: 謝謝祢為我死在十架上
en: Thank You, Lord, for You died upon the cross.
By Your stripes I am once again made whole.
I will give You my praise
for You've healed and set free
all because of Your amazing grace

zh: 被贖教會 洗得清潔
en: Lose all their guilty stains,
Lose all their guilty stains;
And sinners, plunged beneath that flood,
Lose all their guilty stains.
